messages:
jordan: quick postmortem follow-up from last night's eu-central incident. summary: model-alpha p95 spiked ~2.5x for ~45m due to scheduled backup jobs + uneven KV prefix load. we need short-term SLO adjustments, owners for remediation, and a dashboard/watch plan. propose: set temporary p95 SLO to 280ms (eu-central only) for 10 days; reduce throughput target from 720 qps -> 680 qps while we validate batching fixes; create a rolling 6h error-budget alert at 25%. agree?

lee: +1 with eu-only scope. keep global customer SLA intact. I can take dashboard updates and alerting work.

marie: I will own remediation investigation (prefix hash, batch sizing, backup job scheduling). ETA: 2026-03-30. creating RED-4832 now.

irene: oncall note: if error-budget alert fires, page eng-oncall and escalate to infra. please add a runbook step to disable backup job window as a mitigant.

ops-bot: ops-bot: New Jira created RED-4832: "model-alpha: KV prefix skew + backup job collision" by @marie.

jordan: owners: remediation->@marie, dashboard/alerts->@lee, mitigations/runbook->@irene. marie, link jira to the postmortem doc. lee, post dashboard link here when ready.

marie: Jira link: https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/RED-4832. added checklist: reproduce with synthetic burst, run KV histogram, test deterministic hashing, tune min_batch_size. ETA sprints: 1.

lee: Draft dashboard: https://dash.redwood.local/d/model-alpha-slo-eu. Panels: p50/p95/p99, rolling 6h error budget burn, recent deploys, scheduled backup job windows. I added a panel to highlight Fri-Sat midnight spikes detected by recurrence rule.

jordan: good. decision: apply temporary SLO change for eu-central only. TTL 10 days (expiry 2026-04-03T04:00:00Z). if rolling 6h burn > 0.25 -> execute auto-mitigation: pause backup window and fallback routing to model-stable slice.

marie: ran a quick KV histogram during a synthetic burst. top 5 prefixes account for 62% of ops; batch sizes dropped to 1 for those prefixes. hypothesis: hashing seed + recent config changed partition mapping. plan: enforce min_batch_size=3 and set prefix_hash_seed=42, and bump batch_timeout_ms to 15 for test.

marie: config snippet: ```
# inference config
min_batch_size: 3
batch_timeout_ms: 15
prefix_hash_seed: 42
```

irene: please add those test logs to RED-4832. once validated, we'll schedule a controlled rollout with a 45m watch.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Alert rule created by @lee: slo_burn_model_alpha_6h > 0.25 -> page eng-oncall.

lee: PROM query I used for rolling 6h burn: ```sum_over_time((slo_error_total{model="model-alpha",region="eu-central"} / slo_total{model="model-alpha",region="eu-central"})[6h:1m])```

jordan: timeline: marie tests by 2026-03-28, staging canary 2026-03-29, prod rollout 2026-03-30 with 45m watch. lee to update dash with watch annotations. irene to update runbook with backup-job pause steps.

marie: initial test: p95 improved ~18% for hot prefixes under synthetic load. attaching perf diffs to RED-4832.

lee: staging canary looks stable (p95 ~250ms on canary slice). prepping dashboard annotation and alert escalation policy.

irene: will coordinate with infra to temporarily disable backup window if alert fires. adding contact list to runbook.

jordan: thanks team. i'll publish the temporary SLO governance note in the SLO doc and add an expiry tag. we'll revisit at SLO retro and either revert to original SLO or extend after validation. closing thread once prod rollout + jira progress noted.
